create_gaussian_process_classifier: create a GaussianProcessClassifier with isotropic RBF kernel and fit it on iris dataset features
create_rbf_kernel: create an RBF kernel with specified length-scales for isotropic or anisotropic Gaussian process classification
run_gpc_predict_proba: run GaussianProcessClassifier predict_proba on a meshgrid to obtain predicted class probabilities
plot_classification_probabilities: plot predicted classification probabilities as a colored heatmap with training points overlaid
compute_log_marginal_likelihood: compute the log-marginal-likelihood of a fitted GaussianProcessClassifier kernel parameters
